rules.rule: Actual L2 continuousGND: no nonGND signal bridges; existing quiet island/permanentvoid must be re-evaluated, not merely inherited.
rules.acceptance: Native actual generated GND/voids/pads and all layer signal objects verified; intended continuity supported by geometry.

rules.rule: Select actual L3 power domains from physical load/voltage needs. Do not automatically split all rails across the full board. V3V3 may dominate, V5 local supply may remain outer-layer if justified; no unreviewed choice is applied here.
rules.acceptance: Each real polygon has net, feeder, load/current, decoupling, isolation/clearance and boundary record.

rules.rule: BOTTOM signals use actual adjacent L3 reference. Avoid crossing L3 power splits/voids; old L3GND projected coverage cannot certify new planes.
rules.acceptance: Per critical full trace-footprint projection after fill, plus real return/capacitor path and connector ground check.

rules.rule: TOP-L2 GND to BOTTOM-L3 power transition changes reference. GNDstitchvia only joins GND; it cannot directly bond power toGND. Require real close decoupling/appropriate return or change route layer.
rules.acceptance: Real capacitor pin/net/placement/return conductor proof; both signal-via antipads and return detours reviewed. No blanket1.5mm approval.

rules.rule: Preserve local CIN/SW/BOOT/COUT/FB and MCUdecoupling loops; new power plane connectivity does not replace local caps or justify long thin necks.
rules.acceptance: Actual power current branches, effective capMPN, supply/thermal limits and new via/thermal bottlenecks checked.

rules.rule: Fixed uppercase names and full15/17Film templates remain; physicalMASK not added. Electrical function changes require actual copper and native readback.
rules.acceptance: New checkpointSHA, physical/layer net and fullArtwork/output review; all original input boards/templates preserved.

legacyEvidenceBoundary: All j52 actual projection and b019 GND common results are evidence about old actual L3GND only. They are not new-default SI/PI acceptance.
